title: A hybrid model to study how late long-term potentiation is affected by faulty molecules in an intraneuronal signaling network regulating transcription factor CREB.
authors: Emadi, Ali; Ozen, Mustafa; Abdi, Ali
journal: Integrative biology : quantitative biosciences from nano to macro
one_liner_zh: 该文用混合模型研究神经元内信号网络对转录因子CREB的调控及长时程增强影响，虽涉及CREB转录因子，但核心是胞内信号网络而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Systems biology analysis of intracellular signaling networks has tremendously expanded our understanding of normal and diseased cell behaviors and has revealed paths to finding proper therapeutic molecular targets. When it comes to neurons in the human brain, analysis of intraneuronal signaling networks provides invaluable information on learning, memory and cognition-related disorders, as well as potential therapeutic targets. However, neurons in the human brain form a highly complex neural network that, among its many roles, is also responsible for learning, memory formation and cognition. Given the impairment of these processes in mental and psychiatric disorders, one can envision that analyzing interneuronal processes, together with analyzing intraneuronal signaling networks, can result in a better understanding of the pathology and, subsequently, more effective target discovery. In this paper, a hybrid model is introduced, composed of the long-term potentiation (LTP) interneuronal process and an intraneuronal signaling network regulating CREB. LTP refers to an increased synaptic strength over a long period of time among neurons, typically induced upon occurring an activity that generates high-frequency stimulations (HFS) in the brain, and CREB is a transcription factor known to be highly involved in important functions of the cognitive and executive human brain such as learning and memory. The hybrid LTP-signaling model is analyzed using a proposed molecular fault diagnosis method. It allows to study the importance of various signaling molecules according to how much they affect an intercellular phenomenon when they are faulty, i.e. dysfunctional. This paper is intended to suggest another angle for understanding the pathology and therapeutic target discovery by classifying and ranking various intraneuronal signaling molecules based on how much their faulty behaviors affect an interneuronal process. Possible relations between the introduced hybrid analysis and the previous purely intracellular analysis are investigated in the paper as well.
abstract_zh: 细胞内信号传导网络的系统生物学分析极大地拓展了我们对正常及疾病细胞行为的理解，并揭示了寻找合适治疗性分子靶点的途径。就人脑中的神经元而言，神经元内信号传导网络的分析为学习、记忆及认知相关障碍提供了宝贵信息，同时也指出了潜在的治疗靶点。然而，人脑中的神经元形成了一个高度复杂的神经网络，该网络在众多功能中，也负责学习、记忆形成和认知。鉴于这些过程在精神及心理疾病中的受损情况，可以设想，将神经元间过程的分析与神经元内信号传导网络的分析相结合，能够更深入地理解病理机制，并进而实现更有效的靶点发现。本文引入了一种混合模型，该模型由长时程增强（LTP）这一神经元间过程与调控CREB的神经元内信号传导网络组成。LTP指神经元间突触强度在长时间内的增强，通常由大脑中产生高频刺激（HFS）的活动诱导发生，而CREB是一种转录因子，已知高度参与认知及执行功能人脑的重要功能，如学习和记忆。该混合LTP-信号模型采用一种提出的分子故障诊断方法进行分析。该方法允许根据各种信号分子在故障（即功能失调）时对细胞间现象的影响程度，来研究其重要性。本文旨在通过根据各种神经元内信号分子的故障行为对神经元间过程的影响程度对其进行分类和排序，为理解病理及治疗靶点发现提供另一视角。文中还探讨了所提出的混合分析与先前纯细胞内分析之间可能存在的关联。
